title: Winged Victory of Samothrace
medium: Parian marble (the Victory); grey Lartos marble (the ship and its base)
credit: This work is based on “Winged Victory of Samothrace” (sketchfab.com) by CosmoWenman, a scan of the Skulpturhalle Basel’s cast, CC BY 4.0 — its colours turned to the marble’s; the ship drawn simply from the Louvre’s measurements.
